limitations: Auth credentials and platform configuration are not recovered from the fresh public snapshot.
Storage object bytes and Vault secrets are outside this rehearsal.
A real restore into any shared environment requires a separately approved recovery action.
viewDefinitionCoverage: Archive definitions restored; current view SQL requires an independent matching-definition guard because the original public snapshot format omits view definitions.
sequenceCoverage: No public sequences in the prepared schema; relation comparison must confirm none were introduced.
representationNormalization: Function comparison uses exact signature-keyed definitions and ACLs, independent of collation ordering.
Only the known mock_attempts_section_order_check associative AND grouping is normalized from the PostgreSQL 17 spelling to the equivalent PostgreSQL 18 spelling.
